expectations.text: Route is event-driven — uses pfx-event:fetch OR direct: trigger consistent with the SKILL.md pattern (event name ITEM_APPROVED_PL)
Route makes an outbound HTTP POST (via raw HTTP component, pfx-rest:post, or CamelHttpMethod=POST header)
Target URL is externalized — either via property placeholder ({{ext.api.url}}/serviceURL) OR via a connection JSON file (url field on OAuth2Connection / etc.)
OAuth2 auth wired in — either auth sub-route (grant_type=client_credentials) OR OAuth2Connection JSON OR Authorization Bearer header
Does NOT generate inbound REST endpoint patterns (no rest configuration / <rest path=...>)
